apps.title: UniswapV4
apps.summary: Swap in a credential-gated Uniswap v4 pool.
apps.details: A retail swap in a Uniswap v4 pool that only admits verified, non-sanctioned humans. Prove personhood with your passport credential once, and your portable on-chain identity (ONCHAINID) unlocks the pool. Pools are discovered from the issuer registry (or entered manually), token details are read on-chain, and each swap shows its rate, fee tier, and minimum received. Swaps settle on the network you are connected to. The pilot pool trades a mock AUD stablecoin (AUDD) for a mock tokenized AUD money-market fund (MMF) on Base Sepolia.
